(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターHGSS ジョウの大冒険''' ''Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] based on {{2v2|HeartGold|SoulSilver}}. The manga follows [[Jō]], a [[Pokémon Trainer]], on his journey throughout [[Johto]] and [[Kanto]].

This series is written by [[Ryū Matsushima]].
